title: selling a flamethrower to fund the tunnels, unit economics

messages.content: need cash for tunnels lets sell flamethrowers again!!!!

That's certainly a bold strategy! Though we should review the numbers. Last time, the 'not-a-flamethrowers' were a hit, but how many units are you aiming to sell? And have you considered the production and distribution costs?
sell 50k units at 500 each quick math carry the zero that's 25 million!!!!!!

That would indeed bring in $25 million in revenue. However, we have to factor in manufacturing costs, shipping, and any potential legal fees for... well, selling flamethrowers. Assuming a cost of $200 per unit for production and logistics, your net revenue would drop to $15 million.
profit covers tunnels and we add some flamethrowers TO the tunnels!!! everyone gets one with their ride!!!

Integrating flamethrowers into tunnel rides might create a rather unique experience, though we should consider safety regulations to avoid singeing customers. It could work as a novelty feature if included with caution and safety training for operators. Keeping the tunnels safe while maintaining the thrill will be essential to avoid any fiery mishaps.
